parameters.text: =Workers Teleported to task location and tasks assigned.

Worker1.subtask: Build foundation and ENTIRE floor for the house. Foundation is cobblestone ring at Y=-60, floor is oak_planks at Y=-60 inside the ring.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the small house
Worker1.fullPrompt: You are Worker1, positioned at the build site. Stage 1 of 4: FOUNDATION. Your task: Build the complete foundation and floor for an 8x6 house. Coordinates: X:0-7, Z:0-5, Y:-60. Place cobblestone foundation ring around the perimeter (X:0, X:7, Z:0, Z:5) at Y=-60. Fill interior (X:1-6, Z:1-4) with oak_planks at Y=-60. This is the shared floor - Worker2 will NOT rebuild it. Assume you have 64 cobblestone and 128 oak_planks. Do NOT build above Y=-60. Do NOT break existing terrain excessively. Begin building immediately - no navigation needed.
constraints: Build ENTIRE foundation ring (all 4 sides) at Y=-60 using cobblestone
Build ENTIRE floor inside using oak_planks at Y=-60
Do NOT build above Y=-60 in this stage
Do NOT break more than 10 sequential blocks

Worker2.subtask: Prepare east side foundation supports and gather additional materials. Place corner reinforcement posts at east corners.
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the small house
Worker2.fullPrompt: You are Worker2, positioned at the build site. Stage 1 of 4: FOUNDATION. Your task: Place corner reinforcement posts on east side while Worker1 builds the main floor. Coordinates: X:4-7, Z:0-5, Y:-60. Place oak_log posts at corners (X:7, Z:0) and (X:7, Z:5) at Y=-60. Worker1 is building the entire floor - do NOT duplicate floor blocks. Assume you have 32 oak_log and 64 cobblestone. Do NOT build above Y=-60. Do NOT place blocks at X:0-3 (Worker1's section). Begin building immediately - no navigation needed.
constraints: Do NOT place floor blocks (Worker1 handles entire floor)
Place oak_log corner posts at (7,0) and (7,5) at Y=-60
Do NOT build above Y=-60 in this stage
Do NOT break more than 10 sequential blocks
Coordinate with Worker1's foundation work

Worker1.subtask: Build WEST walls of the house. West wall at X=0, portions of front wall (Z=0) from X=0-3, portions of back wall (Z=5) from X=0-3. Walls are 3 blocks tall (Y:-59 to Y:-57) using oak_planks with oak_log corner posts.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the small house
Worker1.fullPrompt: You are Worker1. Stage 2 of 4: WALLS. Build west walls for the house. Coordinates: X:0-3, Z:0-5, Y:-59 to -57. Place oak_log corner posts at (X:0, Z:0) and (X:0, Z:5) from Y:-59 to Y:-57. Build west wall (X:0) with oak_planks, leaving door opening at Z:2-3, Y:-59 to -58. Build front wall section (Z:0) from X:0 to X:3. Build back wall section (Z:5) from X:0 to X:3. Worker2 is building east walls simultaneously. Do NOT place blocks at X:4 or beyond. Assume you have 128 oak_planks and 24 oak_log. Begin immediately.
constraints: Build walls from Y=-59 to Y=-57 (3 blocks high)
Place oak_log at corners (0,0), (0,5)
Use oak_planks for wall sections
Leave space for door at X=0, Z=2-3, Y=-59 to Y=-58
Do NOT place blocks at X=4 or beyond
Do NOT break more than 10 sequential blocks

Worker2.subtask: Build EAST walls of the house. East wall at X=7, portions of front wall (Z=0) from X=4-7, portions of back wall (Z=5) from X=4-7. Walls are 3 blocks tall (Y:-59 to Y:-57) using oak_planks with oak_log corner posts.
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the small house
Worker2.fullPrompt: You are Worker2. Stage 2 of 4: WALLS. Build east walls for the house. Coordinates: X:4-7, Z:0-5, Y:-59 to -57. Place oak_log corner posts at (X:7, Z:0) and (X:7, Z:5) from Y:-59 to Y:-57. Build east wall (X:7) with oak_planks, leaving window opening at Z:2-3, Y:-58. Build front wall section (Z:0) from X:4 to X:7. Build back wall section (Z:5) from X:4 to X:7. Worker1 is building west walls simultaneously. Do NOT place blocks at X:3 or below. Assume you have 128 oak_planks and 24 oak_log. Begin immediately.
constraints: Build walls from Y=-59 to Y=-57 (3 blocks high)
Place oak_log at corners (7,0), (7,5)
Use oak_planks for wall sections
Leave space for window at X=7, Z=2-3, Y=-58
Do NOT place blocks at X=3 or below
Do NOT break more than 10 sequential blocks

Worker1.subtask: Build WEST roof slope. Roof slopes upward from X=0 toward center ridge at X=4. Use oak_stairs facing east (toward ridge). Ridge line is at Y=-54, X=4. Your slope goes from Y=-56 at X=0 up to Y=-54 at X=4.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the small house
Worker1.fullPrompt: You are Worker1. Stage 3 of 4: ROOF. Build west roof slope toward the CENTER RIDGE at X=4, Y=-54. Coordinates: X:0-4, Z:0-5, Y:-56 to -54. Place oak_stairs facing EAST. Row at X=0: place stairs at Y=-56. Row at X=2: place stairs at Y=-55. Row at X=4: place oak_planks or slabs at Y=-54 (this is the ridge peak). Cover Z:0 to Z:5 for each row. The ridge at X=4, Y=-54 is the CENTER of the roof - Worker2's east slope will meet yours here. Ensure seamless connection. Do NOT place blocks beyond X=4. Assume you have 64 oak_stairs and 16 oak_planks. Begin immediately.
constraints: Roof ridge is at X=4, Y=-54 (shared with Worker2)
Use oak_stairs facing EAST (toward ridge at X=4)
Start at Y=-56 at X=0, step up to Y=-55 at X=2, reach Y=-54 at X=4
Cover full Z range (Z:0 to Z:5) for each row
Do NOT place blocks beyond X=4
Your roof MUST meet Worker2's roof at X=4, Y=-54

Worker2.subtask: Build EAST roof slope. Roof slopes upward from X=7 toward center ridge at X=4. Use oak_stairs facing west (toward ridge). Ridge line is at Y=-54, X=4. Your slope goes from Y=-56 at X=7 up to Y=-54 at X=4.
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the small house
Worker2.fullPrompt: You are Worker2. Stage 3 of 4: ROOF. Build east roof slope toward the CENTER RIDGE at X=4, Y=-54. Coordinates: X:4-7, Z:0-5, Y:-56 to -54. Place oak_stairs facing WEST. Row at X=7: place stairs at Y=-56. Row at X=5: place stairs at Y=-55. Row at X=4: Worker1 places ridge blocks - align your stairs to meet the ridge seamlessly. Cover Z:0 to Z:5 for each row. The ridge at X=4, Y=-54 is the CENTER of the roof - your east slope meets Worker1's west slope here. Do NOT place blocks below X=4. Assume you have 64 oak_stairs. Begin immediately.
constraints: Roof ridge is at X=4, Y=-54 (shared with Worker1)
Use oak_stairs facing WEST (toward ridge at X=4)
Start at Y=-56 at X=7, step up to Y=-55 at X=5, reach Y=-54 at X=4
Cover full Z range (Z:0 to Z:5) for each row
Do NOT place blocks below X=4
Your roof MUST meet Worker1's roof at X=4, Y=-54

Worker1.subtask: Add west interior details: Place door at entrance (X=0, Z=2-3), add torch inside on west wall, place crafting table in northwest corner.
Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the small house
Worker1.fullPrompt: You are Worker1. Stage 4 of 4: INTERIOR AND FINISHING. Add finishing details to west interior. Place oak_door at entrance (X:0, Z:2, facing west). Place torch on interior wall at (X:1, Z:4, Y:-58). Place crafting_table in corner at (X:1, Z:1, Y:-59). Do NOT modify walls or roof. Do NOT place items beyond X:3. Worker2 is finishing east side simultaneously. Assume you have 1 oak_door, 4 torches, 1 crafting_table. Begin immediately.
constraints: Place oak_door at X=0, Z=2, Y=-59 (bottom) and Y=-58 (top)
Place torch on wall at X=1, Z=4, Y=-58
Place crafting_table at X=1, Z=1, Y=-59
Do NOT place items beyond X=3
Do NOT break any walls or roof

Worker2.subtask: Add east interior details: Place glass_pane in window (X=7, Z=2-3, Y=-58), add torch inside on east wall, place furnace in northeast corner.
Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the small house
Worker2.fullPrompt: You are Worker2. Stage 4 of 4: INTERIOR AND FINISHING. Add finishing details to east interior. Place glass_pane in window at (X:7, Z:2, Y:-58) and (X:7, Z:3, Y:-58). Place torch on interior wall at (X:6, Z:4, Y:-58). Place furnace in corner at (X:6, Z:1, Y:-59). Do NOT modify walls or roof. Do NOT place items below X:4. Worker1 is finishing west side simultaneously. Assume you have 4 glass_pane, 4 torches, 1 furnace. Begin immediately.
constraints: Place glass_pane at X=7, Z=2 and Z=3, Y=-58
Place torch on wall at X=6, Z=4, Y=-58
Place furnace at X=6, Z=1, Y=-59
Do NOT place items below X=4
Do NOT break any walls or roof

Worker1.objective: Build the WEST half of the small house including west foundation, west walls, west roof slope, and west interior details
Worker1.assumptions: Worker2 is building east half simultaneously. Floor is shared - Worker1 builds entire floor in Stage 1.
Worker1.constraints: Do NOT place blocks at X=4 or beyond (Worker2's territory except shared ridge). Do NOT break more than 10 sequential blocks.

Worker2.objective: Build the EAST half of the small house including east foundation, east walls, east roof slope, and east interior details
Worker2.assumptions: Worker1 is building west half simultaneously. Worker1 builds shared floor. Roof ridge at X=4 is shared.
Worker2.constraints: Do NOT place blocks at X=3 or below (Worker1's territory). Do NOT rebuild floor (Worker1's responsibility). Do NOT break more than 10 sequential blocks.

plan.buildingRequest: Build a small house with roof using 2 workers collaboratively. Workers will divide the structure spatially (west/east) and build simultaneously through 4 stages: foundation, walls, roof, and finishing details.
